title: Acute Solar Particle Event (SPE) & Prodromal Radiation Triage
document_text: title: Acute Solar Particle Event (SPE) & Prodromal Acute Radiation Syndrome (ARS) | text: Triggers when GOES >10 MeV proton flux exceeds 10 pfu or active dosimeter exceeds 100 uSv/hr, or when prodromal triad appears: proton flux spike, core temperature > 38.0 C, resting heart rate +20% above baseline, and acute fatigue or nausea. High-energy solar protons trigger inflammatory cytokine release and hematopoietic/GI stress. Immediate shelter window is 15-45 minutes. Crew actions: abort EVA or LTV rover traversal immediately, drive under 8 km/h to Habitat Central Storm Shelter Airlock Alpha, verify PLSS pressure at 4.3 psi. Hardware directives: DEPLOY_WATER_WALL_SHIELDING, DOSIMETER_HERA_HIGH_RATE_MODE, SET_DOSIMETER_HIGH_FREQ_LOG. Medical kit: Ondansetron 8mg ODT if prodromal nausea occurs.
crew_actions: Abort EVA or Lunar Terrain Vehicle (LTV) traversal immediately.
Navigate at safe speed (< 8 km/h to minimize g-jolts) to Habitat Storm Shelter Airlock Alpha within 18 minutes.
Verify PLSS suit pressure remains nominal at 4.3 psi and prep antiemetics.

title: Chronic GCR / Organ Dose Limit Approach (Radi-N2 & Career 600 mSv)
document_text: title: Chronic Career Radiation & Organ Limit Approach | text: Triggers when cumulative career dose exceeds 85% of NASA 600 mSv limit (510 mSv) or when Radi-N2 daily neutron bubble detector counts show elevated red bone marrow or eye lens dose during Solar Minimum high GCR. Crew actions: restrict future surface EVAs, relocate sleeping assignment to lowest-neutron shielded habitat module mapped via Radi-N2, initiate antioxidant and nutritional countermeasure regimen. Hardware directives: REASSIGN_HABITAT_SLEEP_ZONE, LOG_RADI_N2_BUBBLE_COUNTS.
crew_actions: Restrict non-essential surface EVAs and verify cumulative Radi-N2 neutron log.
Relocate sleeping quarters to lowest-neutron shielded habitat module.
Initiate targeted antioxidant and nutritional countermeasure regimen.

title: Severe Spacesuit Impact / Clavicle Fracture & Decompression Risk
document_text: title: High-Risk Suit Blunt Trauma, Clavicle Fracture & DCS Risk | text: Triggers when LTV rover IMU jolt exceeds 2.5g combined with HBM Hard Upper Torso (HUT) shoulder/clavicle clearance < 12 mm and bone mass retention < 92%, or impact stress > 80% fracture threshold. Osteopenic clavicles and ribs collide with rigid HUT scye ring under terrain vibration. Immediate crew actions: halt rover immediately, perform self-palpation of clavicle and ribs, verify PLSS suit pressure audio integrity for decompression leak. Hardware directives: PLSS_PRESSURE_INTEGRITY_CHECK, PREP_PORTABLE_ULTRASOUND_PNEUMOTHORAX, TEMPUS_PRO_VITALS_LOCK. Medical kit: Acetaminophen 500mg PO or topical immobilization; avoid sedating opioids while suited.
crew_actions: Halt Lunar Terrain Vehicle (LTV) immediately and hold stationary posture.
Perform bilateral self-palpation of clavicles and anterior ribs; assess focal point tenderness.
Verify PLSS suit pressure and audio seal integrity; prep Portable Ultrasound for pneumothorax screen.

med_kit.recommended_agent: Acetaminophen 500mg PO (defer NSAIDs until internal hemorrhage ruled out via ultrasound)

title: Accelerated Microgravity Bone Mineral Decay & ARED Non-Compliance
document_text: title: Accelerated Bone & Muscle Decay (HBM M_bone Trajectory) | text: Triggers when parametric HBM bone mineral decay exceeds 1.5% per month, cumulative retention drops below 94%, or ARED resistive exercise compliance falls below 80% over 14 days. Crew actions: enforce mandatory ARED resistive squat/deadlift schedule adjustment, verify daily Vitamin D3 and calcium supplementation, schedule SLAMMD body mass verification. Hardware directives: ARED_RESISTANCE_AUTO_RECALIBRATE, ARED_INCREASE_NEXT_SESSION_LOAD_5_PCT, SCHEDULE_SLAMMD_MASS_CHECK.
crew_actions: Execute mandatory ARED resistive exercise adjustment (squat/deadlift progression).
Verify daily Vitamin D3 (800-1000 IU) and calcium intake compliance.
Perform SLAMMD body mass measurement within 24 hours.

title: Cardiovascular Instability & Orthostatic Fluid Depletion Crisis
document_text: title: Orthostatic Intolerance & Cardiovascular Fluid Shift Crisis | text: Triggers when systolic BP < 90 mmHg or > 160 mmHg, diastolic BP < 60 or > 100 mmHg, resting heart rate > 120 bpm (or HR > 105 bpm with systolic BP < 95 mmHg and rapid SLAMMD mass drop > 1.5 kg in 48 hours). Microgravity plasma volume loss reduces cardiac preload, causing presyncope/syncope during lunar or Martian gravity transitions or post-EVA. Crew actions: assume supine posture with legs elevated, initiate oral salt-water fluid loading protocol immediately, screen internal jugular vein for thrombosis with Portable Ultrasound. Hardware directives: ACTIVATE_CHIBIS_LBNP_SUIT, DEPLOY_PORTABLE_ULTRASOUND_IJV, AED_STANDBY_MODE.
crew_actions: Assume supine posture immediately with legs elevated to restore cerebral perfusion.
Initiate oral isotonic salt-water fluid loading protocol (1000 mL target).
Deploy Portable Ultrasound to screen Internal Jugular Vein (IJV) flow and keep AED on standby.

med_kit.recommended_agent: Oral Electrolyte Salt-Loading Solution (15g NaCl eq / 1L H2O)

title: Acute Hypoglycemia, Hyperglycemia or Infectious Febrile Crisis
document_text: title: Acute Metabolic Crisis or Infectious Fever Protocol | text: Triggers when blood glucose < 70 mg/dL (hypoglycemia) or > 250 mg/dL (hyperglycemia), or core body temperature > 38.5 C. Symptoms include dizziness, diaphoresis, tremor, confusion, or febrile chills post-EVA. Crew actions: for glucose < 70 mg/dL administer 15g oral glucose gel immediately and recheck in 15 min; for fever > 38.5 C isolate crewmember and run i-STAT blood analyzer for electrolytes, lactate, and blood gases. Hardware directives: RUN_ISTAT_BLOOD_ANALYZER, ACTIVATE_HEPA_UV_SCRUBBERS, QUERY_OFFLINE_OPENFDA_DOSING.
crew_actions: If glucose < 70 mg/dL, administer 15g oral glucose gel immediately and re-test in 15 minutes.
If core temp > 38.5 C, isolate crewmember and perform i-STAT blood gas, electrolyte, and lactate panel.
Verify respiratory status and activate habitat HEPA/UV microbial air scrubbers.

med_kit.recommended_agent: Oral Glucose Gel 15g (if glucose < 70) OR Acetaminophen 650mg + Azithromycin 500mg eval (if infectious fever > 38.5 C)

title: Closed-Habitat CO2 Toxicity & Lunar/Martian Regolith Dust Exposure
document_text: title: Closed-Habitat Hypercapnia (ppCO2 > 3.0 mmHg) & Regolith Dust Toxicity | text: Triggers immediately (< 5 ms NASA-STD-3001 interlock) when cabin ppCO2 > 3.0 mmHg, cabin O2 < 19.5%, cabin pressure drops below 96 kPa, or airborne regolith dust exceeds 0.3 mg/m3. Acute hypercapnia and fine silicate dust impair executive function and irritate alveolar airways. Immediate crew actions: don emergency O2 masks and sealed goggles immediately, isolate contaminated airlock module, perform lung auscultation / ultrasound for airway edema. Hardware directives: ECLSS_CDRA_SCRUBBER_MAX_BOOST, ACTIVATE_ELECTROSTATIC_DUST_REPELLER, SWITCH_EMERGENCY_O2_RESERVE.
crew_actions: Don emergency oxygen masks and sealed protective goggles immediately.
Isolate contaminated habitat or airlock hatch and verify cabin pressure integrity.
Perform post-exposure ocular saline rinse and pulmonary symptom check.

med_kit.recommended_agent: Sterile Isotonic Ophthalmic Flush + Albuterol MDI (if bronchospasm)

title: Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS) Screening
document_text: title: Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS) Early Detection | text: Triggers on multi-system trend: mild hypercapnia (ppCO2 > 2.5 mmHg) + cephalad fluid shift + elevated diastolic BP + mission elapsed time > 60 days + visual acuity shift, hyperopic drift, optic disc edema, or posterior globe flattening on ocular fundus / ultrasound scan. Headward fluid shift + CO2 vasodilation elevates intracranial pressure. Crew actions: capture bilateral ocular ultrasound and retinal fundus scan, boost CDRA CO2 scrubbing below 2.0 mmHg, consider LBNP fluid redistribution session. Hardware directives: ECLSS_CDRA_CO2_TARGET_SUB_2MMHG, CAPTURE_OCULAR_FUNDUS_SCAN, SCHEDULE_CHIBIS_LBNP_SESSION.
crew_actions: Capture bilateral retinal fundus photograph and optic nerve sheath diameter ultrasound.
Verify habitat ppCO2 scrubbing below 2.0 mmHg target and log visual acuity grid.
Schedule supervised Chibis LBNP lower-body fluid redistribution session.

med_kit.recommended_agent: Acetazolamide 125-250mg eval (Flight Surgeon protocol) + Electrolyte hydration check

title: Hypercapnic Cognitive Burnout & Severe Sleep/Isolation Deterioration
document_text: title: Severe Sleep Deprivation, Isolation Mood Drop & Hypercapnic Cognitive Burnout | text: Triggers when daily sleep < 5.0-5.5 hrs across 3-day rolling average (versus NASA 8.5 hr target), mood score <= 3/10 (or <= 2/5 on Aegis scale), cognitive reaction time degrades, or cabin ppCO2 > 2.5-3.0 mmHg compounds fatigue. Crew actions: defer hazardous EVA or docking maneuvers, enforce mandatory 8.5 hour protected sleep block, optimize circadian lighting. Hardware directives: CIRCADIAN_LED_SPECTRUM_SHIFT, ECLSS_CO2_SCRUBBER_BOOST, UNLOCK_PRIVATE_PSYCH_SUPPORT.
crew_actions: Defer safety-critical EVA, robotics, or rover piloting duties for 24 hours.
Enforce mandatory 8.5-hour protected acoustic/dark sleep block.
Engage circadian lighting shift (suppress pre-sleep blue spectrum; boost 480nm post-wake).

med_kit.recommended_agent: Melatonin 0.5-3mg PRN 60min pre-sleep (non-sedating circadian phase anchor)

title: Nominal Baseline Health & Microgravity Adaptation Maintenance
document_text: title: Nominal Astronaut Health & Routine Microgravity Countermeasures | text: All cardiovascular, metabolic, radiation, ECLSS habitat, and HBM biomechanical parameters within NASA-STD-3001 nominal green envelope. Mild baseline resting HR elevation or transient fluid shift without threshold breach represents normal spaceflight adaptation. Crew actions: continue daily ARED resistive workout, maintain 2.5L hydration, log evening sleep and mood telemetry to earn daily Aegis XP. Hardware directives: LOG_NOMINAL_TELEMETRY_SYNC, CONTINUE_STANDARD_ECLSS_CYCLE.
crew_actions: All physiological and habitat thresholds nominal; continue scheduled ARED/CEVIS exercise.
Maintain >= 2.5L fluid intake and 8.5-hour sleep window.
Log daily crew check-in to record Aegis XP progression.
